title: Identity: the platform's OIDC provider emits the standard `locale` claim at userinfo (profile scope), so a hosted environment's JIT sign-in follows the cloud account language
body:
Filing gate ②: the framework half of the ruling the maintainer gave on objectstack-ai/cloud#3125 (batch #387 item 1, column 现在立 card 5: 「用户语言偏好随云账号进入每个环境」, platform first). This is the producer half that #25261 (the reader, landed as `829cb779`) assumed exists. Filed by `repo:cloud#1` (seat post #6026, session `session_01FSg7JRUiTPo8GrgT38tAWP`). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** the objectstack lane. objectstack-ai/cloud#3159, the cloud half, is `Blocked-by:` this card. It resumes as a pin bump plus a local-stack reading.

## Measured (pinned tree `f0fdd45bbc83`, better-auth 1.7.12, `@better-auth/oauth-provider` 1.7.12)
The source is the cloud dev report on objectstack-ai/cloud#3159 (comment `6373436798`).

- The OP is composed only inside plugin-auth: `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts:4252` (`return [jwtPlugin, oauthProvider({`; line 4241 on `main` `1ff43b67`). It passes `customAccessTokenClaims`, but no `customUserInfoClaims` and no `customIdTokenClaims`. A host only switches the OP on (`plugins.oidcProvider: true`); it gets no claim seam and no host-plugin seam.
- The platform's own RP reads the claim from **userinfo**. That RP is plugin-auth `genericOAuth` with no custom `getUserInfo`. better-auth uses the decoded ID token only when it carries both `sub` and `email`. oauth-provider 1.7.12 keeps the standard profile claims out of the ID token (`ID_TOKEN_SCOPE_CLAIM_GUARDS`), so the RP GETs `/oauth2/userinfo`. That body becomes `source.oauth.profile`, which `idp-locale-claim.ts` reads.
- So today a hosted environment never receives `locale`, and #25261's reader never fires on the cloud path.
- `locale` is not a better-auth `additionalField` (`sys-user.object.ts`, the #13881 block), so the user object the provider hands a claims hook carries no `locale`. The value has to be read through the data engine.

## Wanted
- In plugin-auth's `oauthProvider({...})`, add `customUserInfoClaims`. It returns `{ locale }` when the granted scopes include `profile` and the user's `sys_user.locale` (read through the data engine, in system context) is a non-empty BCP-47 tag. Otherwise it returns nothing.
- ⛔ No new host configuration key and no new column. Every ObjectStack OP emits the standard claim (OIDC Core 5.1), not only the cloud's.

## Acceptance
- A test on the OP: userinfo carries `locale: "zh-CN"` for a user with `zh-CN` under the `profile` scope. It omits the claim for a user with no locale, and when `profile` was not granted.
- Ablation: drop the hook and the test goes red.
- If the suite can drive one round trip, the platform RP's JIT path stores the claim (#25261's reader) end to end.

## Dedupe
`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack userinfo locale claim` returns 1 hit: #25261 (closed, the RP reader; it does not cover the OP). No other card was found.
